Transport Modes

كيس كبير

A flexible intermediate bulk container (FIBC), usually made of woven polypropylene, designed for storing and transporting dry, flowable products such as sand, fertilizer, or grain.

Definition

A flexible intermediate bulk container (FIBC), usually made of woven polypropylene, designed for storing and transporting dry, flowable products such as sand, fertilizer, or grain.
